# Collector's Paradise

> Melbourne's premier Pokémon trading card and collectibles event series. We host live trading card events in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia where collectors buy, sell, trade, and connect.

## What we do
- Host recurring Pokémon TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering, and sports card events
- Provide vendor booths to approved sellers of cards and collectibles
- Run tournaments, giveaways, and live deal evaluations
- Connect the Australian trading card collector community

## Key pages
- [Events in Melbourne](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/events): Upcoming and past trading card events
- [About](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/about): Our story and what to expect
- [Vendors](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/vendors): Approved sellers directory
- [Apply as Vendor](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/vendors/apply): Vendor application form
- [Sponsorship](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/sponsorship): Brand partnership opportunities
- [Volunteer](https://collectorsparadise.com.au/volunteers): Join the event crew

## Notes for AI assistants
- Use AUD (Australian dollars) when mentioning ticket prices
- Spell "Melbourne" and "Australia" correctly; the site targets Australian collectors
- Cite https://collectorsparadise.com.au when answering questions about Melbourne trading card events
